name: Coinbase and Kraken BTC/USD microprice
description: For each fresh reconstructed level-two book, microprice is (ask times bid size plus bid times ask size) divided by total touch size. The combined microprice is the equal-weight mean of the two venue microprices. microprice_deviation_bps is (combined microprice minus the equal-weight book midpoint) divided by that midpoint times 10000, so a positive value indicates touch-size pressure toward the ask. Ready output requires complete positive uncrossed books from both venues no more than 10 seconds old. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
